# API Key Lab

> Know your AI provider API key works, before you ship.

API Key Lab is an open-source web app that verifies AI provider API keys and reports real health: authentication, model access, a live completion, latency, token usage, and quota/rate-limit signals. It also includes a dedicated chatbot page to chat with the same key via streaming responses.

- Live site: https://apikeylab.vercel.app/
- Chatbot: https://apikeylab.vercel.app/chat
- Repository: https://github.com/muhammadsami987123/api-key-lab
- License: MIT
- Author: Muhammad Sami Asghar Mughal (https://muhammad-sami.vercel.app)

## What it checks

1. Authentication — whether the provider accepts the key.
2. Model access — which models are available and a suggested model.
3. Live completion — a real small request to catch billing, quota, rate-limit, and model-access issues that a simple auth/model-list check can miss.

## Supported providers

OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google Gemini, Groq, Mistral AI, OpenRouter, xAI (Grok), DeepSeek, Together AI, Perplexity, Ollama (local, browser-direct), Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI.

## Key pages

- Home / key tester: https://apikeylab.vercel.app/
- Chatbot: https://apikeylab.vercel.app/chat
- Security model: https://apikeylab.vercel.app/security
- Privacy policy: https://apikeylab.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms of use: https://apikeylab.vercel.app/terms

## Security & privacy (summary)

- Keys are kept in browser session storage and are cleared on tab close/reload flows designed by the app; do not paste keys you are not allowed to transmit.
- Verification/chat requests go through stateless serverless proxy endpoints (`/api/verify`, `/api/chat`) for proxied providers; Ollama/local flows can run browser-direct.
- No accounts, analytics, or key database are part of the app design. See the Security and Privacy pages for full details.

## API endpoints

- `POST /api/verify` — verify a key or list models (provider-specific config in request body).
- `POST /api/chat` — send chat messages; supports streaming SSE responses.
